group: Normalization when ID matches a known VersionFlag

cases.description: The supplied id exactly matches one of the VersionFlag ids, therefore the method should detect it in the first loop (found = true) and return the original id without any further processing.
The supplied id matches the VersionFlag for Draft‑2019‑09. The method should return the id unchanged.
The id does not match any VersionFlag, but contains "://json-schema.org/draft" and the substring "/draft-07/". The method should replace the whole id with SchemaId.V7.
Unnormalized id containing "/draft/2019-09/" should be normalized to SchemaId.V201909.
Unnormalized id containing "/draft/2020-12/" should be normalized to SchemaId.V202012.
Unnormalized id containing "/draft-04/" should be normalized to SchemaId.V4.
Unnormalized id containing "/draft-06/" should be normalized to SchemaId.V6.
The id contains "json-schema.org/draft" but none of the specific substrings matched; the method should leave the id unchanged.

group: No normalization needed (does not contain draft marker)

cases.description: The id does not contain "json-schema.org/draft" and also does not match any VersionFlag, so it should be returned unchanged.
Empty string is not a match for any VersionFlag and does not contain the draft marker; the method should simply return the empty string.
Passing null causes a NullPointerException when the method attempts to call id.contains(...). The test should verify that the exception is thrown.

group: Normalization precedence when multiple draft substrings present

cases.description: The string contains both "/draft-07/" and "/draft-06/". The method checks for "/draft-07/" first, so it should normalize to the V7 meta‑schema.
Both "/draft/2019-09/" and "/draft-07/" appear; the earlier check for "/draft-07/" wins, resulting in V7 normalization.
The method uses case‑sensitive `contains`. Because the marker "://json-schema.org/draft" is not found in the upper‑case form, the id is returned unchanged.

group: Missing trailing slash after version substring

cases.description: The substring "/draft-07/" is not present (no trailing slash), so no normalization occurs.
Again, the required "/draft-07/" pattern is missing; the method should leave the id untouched.
The outer check looks for "://json-schema.org/draft". Because the string contains "json-schema.org/draft" but not the exact prefix, no normalization is performed.
The scheme does not matter; the presence of "://json-schema.org/draft" and "/draft-07/" triggers normalization to the V7 meta‑schema.

group: Normalization with query parameters and fragment

cases.description: Even though the original id contains a query string and a fragment, the method replaces the whole id with the canonical V7 identifier.

group: Already normalized but with extra fragment

cases.description: The id does not exactly match any VersionFlag (extra fragment), so the unnormalized branch runs and normalizes it to the standard V7 identifier.

group: Empty string containing draft marker but no specific version

cases.description: The string contains the draft marker but none of the specific version substrings, therefore the method returns the original id unchanged.
